title: Extend 2.5: better, faster, cheaper document processing
summary: Extend 2.5 makes Parse, Classify, and Split faster and cheaper. Light Parse costs $2 per 1,000 pages, with word-level citations and free ZDR.
body_markdown:
Every developer has been told the rule: good, fast, or cheap. Pick two.


Document processing has mostly worked that way until now. Want something fast and cheap? Well, that’ll come with a hit on accuracy. Good and fast? Be prepared to pay for it.


We kept seeing our customers forced to design around those constraints, instead of getting to just focus on building the best product possible.


As developers ourselves, we wanted to build the product that we wanted to use.


**Today, we’re releasing Extend 2.5: good, fast, cheap. Pick all three.**


Our ML team has been hard at work, training new models to make document parsing, classification, and splitting better and faster. They also rebuilt our inference stack, which resulted in some nice savings that we’re excited to pass on to you by reducing prices across the board.


## TL;DR


1. **Parse:**


- Light Parse is 3.2× faster and cheaper at $2.00 per 1,000 pages (citations included).
- Performance Parse is 6.8× faster and cheaper at $10 per 1,000 pages (citations included).


2. **Classify:** New Instant classification engine built on a decision model, delivering sub-second classification at $1 per 1,000 pages.
3. **Split:** Faster, more accurate, and 50% cheaper at $2.50 per 1,000 pages.
4. **Pay-as-you-go:** Credits now cost 20% less (1 credit = 1 cent).


## Build without constraints


Today, Extend powers some of the most important documents in the world, from real-time user experiences at companies like[Brex](https://www.extend.ai/resources/how-brex-reached-99-accuracy-across-millions-of-financial-documents) and[Mercury](https://www.extend.ai/resources/mercury-case-study) to high-volume enterprise workloads at[C.H. Robinson](https://www.extend.ai/customers) ,[Flatiron Health](https://www.extend.ai/resources/flatiron-case-study) ,[FactSet](https://www.extend.ai/customers) , and[Opendoor](https://www.extend.ai/resources/opendoor-case-study) .


We know how annoying it is when your infra holds you back. So that’s why we’re building Extend the way we’d want any of our own infra to operate:


- private by default (with[no ZDR tax](https://www.extend.ai/resources/dont-pay-the-zdr-tax) )
- [open sourcing useful parts of our stack](https://www.extend.ai/resources/open-source)
- and, most importantly, getting better, faster, and cheaper over time


Here’s how the team pulled that off in Extend 2.5:


## Parse: faster and cheaper, just as accurate


For Extend 2.5, we trained new form and table models and re-engineered inference end to end. We wrote about our[speculative decoding and DFlash experiments](https://www.extend.ai/resources/table-parsing-with-dflash) , which made median table parsing about 4× faster than with speculation off in tests on a single H100 with one request in flight.


Both engines include word- and element-level citations at no extra charge (some providers double their rates for this, so double-check before you choose).


### Light Parse


Launched in August,[Light Parse](https://www.extend.ai/resources/introducing-light-parse) was the first non-agentic parser to pair high accuracy, table support, and word-level grounding at subcent-per-page pricing. In Extend 2.5, median latency drops from 8.07 seconds to 2.5 seconds **(3.2× faster) at $2.00 per 1,000 pages** , making it fast enough for live flows and cheap enough for full archives.


### Performance Parse


Performance Parse is our highest-accuracy engine. With Extend 2.5, latency drops from 19.67 seconds to 2.9 seconds **(6.8× faster) at $10 per 1,000 pages** , bringing frontier parsing into real-time territory. Performance Parse and Auto also return[typed form fields](https://docs.extend.ai/parsing/form-structured-output) , including empty fields, checkbox states, and exact page coordinates.


### Performance on RealDoc-Bench


In the latest[RealDoc-Bench](https://www.extend.ai/resources/realdocbench#cost-latency) results, Light Parse reaches 92.7% per-field document Q&A accuracy while Performance Parse reaches 94.2%. Both sit on the cost–accuracy Pareto frontier.


RealDoc-Bench is our open-source, independently reproducible benchmark built from real-world documents. We encourage you to[evaluate it on your own documents](https://github.com/extend-hq/realdoc-bench) .

## Classify Instant: sub-second document routing


Before a document reaches the right extractor or agent, your pipeline has to know what it is. Classify Instant pairs a new decision model with LLMs to classify files and return confidence scores in under a second, at $1 per 1,000 pages.


Standard Classify ($5 per 1,000 pages) is also faster and more accurate, and both return confidence scores by default so you can route edge cases cleanly in code.


## Split: the cheapest and most accurate splitter on the market


Split finds where each document begins and ends so your pipeline can process every piece cleanly. Our improved Split engine is faster, more accurate, and 50% cheaper at $2.50 per 1,000 pages.


This is now the cheapest and most accurate splitter on the market.


**Paired with Light Parse, you can parse and split a 200-page packet in a few seconds for $0.90 total on the pay-as-you-go plan.**


## Pricing: lower rates without any gotchas


Alongside our engine upgrades, we cut the pay-as-you-go price per credit by 20% ($0.0125 to $0.01 per credit).


We’ve all been on the other side of a vendor pricing page: “contact sales,” a surprise security tax, an invoice that doesn’t match what you expected. We don’t want to be that vendor. Here’s what doesn’t change:


- **No ZDR tax.**[Zero data retention](https://www.extend.ai/resources/dont-pay-the-zdr-tax) is free on any paid plan, including pay-as-you-go. No annual contract, no platform fee, and zero training on your data.
- **No surprises on the bill.** Studio shows a cost estimate before you run anything, and the API returns an[itemized breakdown](https://docs.extend.ai/changelog/2026/6/10) afterward.
- **Free to try.** New accounts start with $100 in free credits. That covers 50,000 pages for free on Light Parse.
- **We’ll keep lowering costs.** We’re investing heavily in models, datasets, and infrastructure, and we’ll keep passing the savings to you.


## Good, fast, cheap. Pick all three.


Our mission is to automate every document, and we’ll keep pushing until cost and speed are never the reason you can’t.
